title: Money
description: Canonical monetary value with currency, amount, and precision. Owner: platform/contracts. Consumers must not alter currency interpretation semantics.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

amount.description: Decimal amount as a string to avoid floating-point rounding. Scale is determined by the currency's standard minor-unit count.

precision.description: Number of decimal places used for the amount. Defaults to the currency standard (e.g., 2 for USD). Must not change the semantic interpretation of the amount.
